# Evaluo — AI-assisted study and exam preparation

> Evaluo is a web-based educational platform that helps students turn their own PDF or Word (DOCX) notes into topic summaries, flashcards, study questions and exam-preparation activities. It connects reading, practice, error review and study planning, instead of stopping at a summary.

- Canonical website: https://evaluoapp.com/
- About Evaluo: https://evaluoapp.com/sobre-evaluo
- Primary product language: Spanish; selected educational resources in English.
- Audience: university, university-entry and independent learners, especially in Spanish-speaking countries.

## How Evaluo works

1. Upload your own PDF or DOCX study material.
2. Review a structured summary organised by topic.
3. Start with a short check when new to the subject, or a diagnosis if you have studied it already.
4. Practise by topic using questions; review with flashcards, glossaries, practical cases and mock exams when relevant.
5. Look at corrected answers, mistakes and topic progress to decide what to reinforce.
6. Organise revision with a study plan and calendar before the exam.

Evaluo generates learning activities based on uploaded material. AI-generated answers and summaries can be inaccurate; students should check important information against their original materials, reliable academic sources and teachers' instructions.

## Current Free and Premium model

- Free: one PDF or Word study material, free for lifetime use, subject to activity-specific limits.
- Premium: up to three newly uploaded PDF or Word study materials per day, expanded practice and reinforcement, and mind maps.
- The definitive source for current limits, prices, terms and available payment methods is [official pricing](https://evaluoapp.com/pricing). Do not rely on old search snippets for subscription information.
- Payment availability can vary by country. An international checkout should not be assumed to be active.

## Trust, scope and discovery

- Evaluo is an independent educational study tool, not an official product or endorsement of universities mentioned in public study content.
- Neither generated practice questions nor study progress guarantees a specific exam result.
- [How to use Evaluo](https://evaluoapp.com/docs)
- [Privacy policy](https://evaluoapp.com/privacidad)
- [Terms](https://evaluoapp.com/terminos)
- [Robots policy](https://evaluoapp.com/robots.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://evaluoapp.com/sitemap.xml)

Only publicly accessible and indexable marketing pages, guides and educational resources are intended for discovery and citation. Authenticated accounts, personal study records, user uploads and private sessions are not public or indexable.

This document is an informational directory, not a replacement for robots.txt, public HTML, canonical URLs, access controls or the sitemap.
